hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.keelokit/bin/guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo 'Keelokit: python3 not found, so the guard is off. Install Python 3.11+.' >&2; exit 0; }; exec python3 "$f" --claude

d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.keelokit/bin"; [ -f "$d/ledger.py" ] || [ -f "$d/doctor.py" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo 'Keelokit: python3 not found, so the guard and doctor are off. Install Python 3.11+.'; exit 0; }; if [ -f "$d/ledger.py" ]; then python3 "$d/ledger.py" history --ensure || :; fi; if [ -f "$d/doctor.py" ]; then python3 "$d/doctor.py" --brief; fi; exit 0
